Hi Name1 and Name2,

Hey there! It’s time for October’s coffee chat.

First, thank you for your patience as we worked through updating and automating the coffee chat pairing process. We know coffee chat invites were missed over the last few months, and we appreciate everyone bearing with us while we got things back on track.

Coffee chats are a great way to reconnect, meet new people, and continue building meaningful relationships within our group. We recommend the following:

1. Find a common 15–30 minute window to meet by the end of the month.
2. Coffee is optional, but turning your video on is highly encouraged. It helps make the conversation more personal and engaging.
3. Take a quick screenshot of your chat and share it in the dist_dtt_general Slack channel along with a short summary of your conversation. We love seeing everyone connect.

Name2, for this cycle, you will be responsible for setting up the coffee chat. Please reach out if you have any difficulty finding a time that works.

To help get the conversation started, feel free to use any of the questions below:

1. What’s something you’ve learned recently that surprised you?
2. What’s one tool, app, or AI feature you’ve started using that you actually find useful?
3. What’s the best recommendation someone has given you recently—restaurant, show, travel spot, book, or anything else?
4. If you could work from anywhere in the world for one month, where would you choose?
5. If you could instantly become an expert in one non-work-related skill, what would it be?

Hope you both have a great conversation!

Best,  
Jonathan 
Data & Technology Transformation  
New York, NY

Hi Name1, Name2, and the rest of the group,

Hey there! It's time for our quarterly coffee chat circle.

Coffee chats help foster meaningful conversations and build new and existing friendships within our group. We recommend the below practices for coffee chats:
1. Find a common 30-45 minute window to meet by the end of the quarter.
2. Coffee is optional, but turning on your video is highly recommended! Having your camera on encourages conversation and relationship building.
3. Take a screenshot of your chat and share it in the dist_dtt_general Slack channel along with a summary of your conversation. It's great to see everyone enjoying coffee chats.

Name1, for this cycle you will be responsible for setting up the coffee chat. Please reach out to the group if you have any difficulty finding a common time that works.

To help drive some conversation, feel free to use the below questions:
1. What's your favorite way to reset or recharge at the start of a new year?
2. What was the highlight of your year last year?
3. What's your go-to way to beat the January blues?



Best,
Raj

______________________________
